title: Test forms in U are closed under multiplication by C^∞ functions
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ∞ g), and let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) = TestFormOn U n. Thus ω is a C^∞ n-form on ℝ^P whose topological support is compact and contained in U. Then the n-form x ↦ g(x)·ω(x) also belongs to 𝒟ⁿ(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → (fun x => g x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∈ TestFormOn U n
